mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 1%, indicating aggressive monetary easing, this triggers a significant rise in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced policy tightness.
failure_condition: 20d returns not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses below 1%, or returns revert to baseline within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 1% and rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) creates a synergistic effect, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as both signals indicate economic expansion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 > previous quarter's value
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher than when FEDFUNDS or GDPC1 alone trigger the signal, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate below 5% signals labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 5%, or returns revert within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the INDPRO index above 105 indicates robust production growth, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO exceeds 105, or returns decline within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above trend signals strong demand, driving corporate earnings growth and equity price appreciation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 rises, or returns revert within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in production (INDPRO > 105) and labor market tightening (UNRATE < 5%) creates a dual positive signal for economic growth, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both signals occur, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in federal funds rate below 1% combined with rising RSAFS (demand) creates a powerful easing signal, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as both indicators confirm economic expansion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and RSAFS > previous month's value
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly higher than when either signal alone triggers, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 2-year window.
